items.reading_block_html: The governing problem is how perception-bound human nature can generate knowledge, factual reality, selfhood, affective order, property, morality, and political authority without access to substance, intrinsic power, natural right, or an external tribunal.

items.reading_block_html: The global thesis is operational and anti-substantialist: contents are inherited from perception and affect, relations organize them, force activates them, repetition stabilizes them, and recursive institutions convert stabilized effects into objects, identities, and norms.
